note: *Sto bene* = I'm fine. The opposite is *male*.
*Mi sento male* = I feel ill.
*Così così* = so-so. *È così bello!* = It's so beautiful!
*Parla piano!* = Speak quietly! / Speak slowly!
*Parla più forte* = speak louder. Also an adjective: *strong*.
The usual answer to an invitation: *Volentieri!* = I'd love to!
Literally *well or badly*: *Bene o male, ce l'ho fatta.*
*Non l'ho fatto apposta!* = I didn't do it on purpose!
As an adverb it never changes: *molto belle*. As an adjective it does: *molte case*.
*Poco caro* = not very expensive. *Un po'* = a bit.
*Più tardi* = later. *Non più* = no longer.
Same meaning as *solamente* and *soltanto*.
*Abbastanza bene* = quite well.
*Circa cento persone* = about a hundred people.
Also *as soon as*: *Appena arrivo, ti chiamo.*
*Piuttosto caro* = rather expensive.
*Arrivo subito!* = I'm coming right away!
*C'era una volta…* = Once upon a time…
Also *tra poco*.
*Ormai è tardi* = It's too late now.
Before the verb: *Non parlo inglese.* With *mai, niente, nessuno* it stays: *non vedo niente*.
*Davvero?* = Really?
*Magari domani* = maybe tomorrow. On its own: *Magari!* = I wish!
*Proprio così!* = Exactly!
*Neanche io* = me neither.
Corrects what was just said: *Non è caro, anzi!*
